needs_manual_review_reason: Series-level GEO metadata verified directly against the live source; per-sample clinical/pathology fields (grade, sex/age, anatomic location, brain invasion, treatment timepoint) have not yet been extracted from individual GSM records or supplementary tables -- part of the batch-1 scaling pass, prioritizing breadth of verified accessions over per-sample depth. Publication metadata pulled from PubMed esummary; not yet manually spot-checked against the full text for every record in this batch. FOLLOW-UP PUBLICATION SEARCH (2026-07-13), match found and directly confirmed: fetched the live PMC full text (PMC10239356, via pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov) of Mundi et al. 2023 (PMID 37061969, Cancer Discovery, 'A Transcriptome-Based Precision Oncology Platform for Patient-Therapy Alignment in a Diverse Set of Treatment-Resistant Malignancies'); its Data Availability table explicitly lists a row 'RNASeq of meningioma tumors sequenced at CUIMC' mapped directly to GEO accession GSE212377 -- an exact, unambiguous accession-to-row match, not a topic guess. Note: the related record gse-197763-bulk-rnaseq (same corresponding authors, GEO Series_summary describing an overlapping '103 meningioma patient tumors... used to derive a meningioma gene regulatory network') was also checked against this same paper's full text and does NOT appear anywhere in it; only GSE212377 and GSE212854 (PDX/cell-line RNASeq) are cited. GSE212377's own Series_overall_design ('RNAseq profiles of 102 meningioma patient tumors... used to derive a meningioma gene regulatory network (interactome)') is near-identical wording to GSE197763's meningioma-subset description, submitted ~5 months later (Aug 2022 vs Mar 2022), suggesting GSE212377 may be a cleaner re-deposit of the same specimens that the paper's own Data Availability statement treats as canonical -- flagged here for a possible_duplicate_needs_verification check in a future dedup pass, not resolved in this session (out of scope for this pass). Publication added; publication_status normal so tags.peer_reviewed set true. AUTHOR-LIST AND CORRESPONDING-AUTHOR FIX (2026-07-14 deep audit): publications[0].authors was truncated to the first 6 of the paper's actual 55 authors; expanded to the full list via Europe PMC's authorString field. Separately, corresponding_author was wrong: it had been set to 'Prabhjot S Mundi, Mariano J Alvarez', assuming the first-listed author (Mundi, the clinical fellow) was co-corresponding. A live web search cross-checked against the AACR publisher page and PMC listing confirms the paper's actual designated corresponding authors are Mariano J. Alvarez, Andrew L. Kung, and Andrea Califano (the senior computational-biology/oncology PIs); Mundi PS is the first author, not a corresponding author. Corrected to 'Mariano J Alvarez, Andrew L Kung, Andrea Califano'. This is the same class of error flagged elsewhere in this audit: assuming corresponding authorship from author-list position rather than confirming the actual designated correspondence.
duplicate_notes: Likely overlaps with gse-197763-bulk-rnaseq's meningioma subset (same 102-103 count, same Columbia PI trio Mundi/Alvarez/Califano, near-identical 'gene regulatory network (interactome)' design text; this series appears to be a cleaner standalone re-deposit of the same cohort ~5-6 months later, and is the one this record's own linked paper's Data Availability table actually cites) -- not confirmed at the patient level, flagged for a future dedup pass.
